name: Akira Satou
source: Having just received a promotion, Akira has found her latest step up the corporate ladder a mixed blessing. On the one hand, it will mean a better career and more job stability in the long run, but in the short term it means breaking up a relationship she was happy with and settling down in a new homeland and work environment at the side of two parents she's long since given up on.
